prayerExcerpt.en-US: Our Lady of the Most Blessed Sacrament, Mother and Model of Adorers, pray for us who have recourse to thee!
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Nossa Senhora do Santíssimo Sacramento, Mãe e Modelo dos adoradores, rogai por nós que recorremos a vós!

meta.face: A slight man of about fifty-five, clean-shaven, with a long, narrow face tapering to a pointed chin — a very high, domed forehead with the hair receding at the temples, a long, straight nose with a fine ridge, deep-set, intense grey-blue eyes under thin, straight brows, hollow cheeks under distinct cheekbones, a thin, compressed mouth; brown hair greying and combed back, falling behind the ears to the collar, and a rapt gaze fixed on the Host.
meta.basis: Follows his 19th-century photographs and the La Seyne portrait: a thin, clean-shaven face with a very high, receding forehead, deep-set eyes and hair worn long behind the ears, in cassock and French bands. He died at fifty-seven.
meta.excerpt: Eymard's invocation, as given in P.-J. Eymard, Month of Our Lady of the Blessed Sacrament (New York: Fathers of the Blessed Sacrament, 1903), https://archive.org/details/monthofourladyof00eymauoft; pt-BR our rendering. The feast has no proper formulary in the repo.
